description:
Program Overview

The Alan Turing Institute PhD Student Enrichment Scheme provides fully funded placements for PhD students to spend 6 or 9 months at the Turing's offices in London, immersing themselves in the UK's national institute for data science and AI. This is an excellent opportunity to enhance your PhD research with access to researchers and facilities.

Funding & Benefits

  • Stipend: £1,200 per month (in addition to your existing PhD stipend)
  • Travel Allowance: Up to £1,500 for travel to and from London
  • Accommodation: Free accommodation in London (or £1,000/month allowance)
  • Duration: 6 or 9 months
  • Location: The Alan Turing Institute, London, UK
  • Additional Benefits: Access to Turing events, networks, and research groups

Eligibility Criteria

  • Enrollment: PhD students at UK universities (any discipline, but AI/CS preferred)
  • Research Area: Data science, AI, or related fields
  • Stage: Typically second or third-year PhD students
  • Nationality: Open to UK and international students

Application Process

  1. Check application window.
  2. Submit online application with CV and research statement.
  3. Review and selection process.
  4. Notification of award.
  5. Placement at Turing.

Required Documents

  • Research Statement (2-page outline of PhD research and alignment with Turing's interests)
  • CV highlighting academic achievements and AI/CS experience
  • Letter of Support from PhD supervisor
  • Transcript (proof of PhD enrollment)

Timeline & Deadlines

MilestoneDate
Application DeadlineMarch 2027 (Expected)
Notification DateMay 2027
Start DateSeptember 2027 or January 2028

Official Link

https://www.turing.ac.uk

Important Notes

  • Align your research statement with Turing's current focus areas (AI safety, data-centric AI, AI for science).
  • Highlight how the placement will advance your PhD research.
  • Must be enrolled in a UK PhD program to be eligible.

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

About Alan Turing Institute

The Alan Turing Institute is the United Kingdom's national institute for data science and artificial intelligence, based in London. It brings researchers together to develop methods and applications across different sectors. Its work includes research, training and partnerships that explore how data and AI can address scientific and societal challenges.

Official website: https://turing.ac.uk

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: March 2027 (Expected). Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.
